Source [S1] and [S2] also confirm that FVR relies on the Fourier projection-slice theorem, has a time complexity of O(N^2 log N) for the rendering loop (per view), and is a faster alternative to spatial domain algorithms which are O(N^3). Source [S8] confirms the use of a '5x5x5 POCS filter' to minimize aliasing. However, the claim states that Hamming-windowed sinc filters are 'required'.
